aboutContent: I hold a Master’s degree in Engineering, and I’ve had the privilege of working with major software companies as well as a variety of clients around the world, in English, French and Japanese. I’ve contributed both as part of collaborative teams and in solo projects, giving me the versatility to adapt to different workflows and deliver value in any setting. From building intuitive, responsive front-end interfaces to designing scalable back-end systems, I enjoy taking projects end-to-end and turning ideas into reality.
aboutHeadlineB: — a full-stack software engineer with 4 years of professional experience.

bbSakura.description: I delivered new front-end features for a B2B network resource management platform, built a new admin panel from scratch, and introduced end-to-end and unit testing to establish a reliable QA process.
bbSakura.name: BBSakura Networks, Inc.

digirise.name: Digirise Inc.

exaWizards.description: I’ve built and launched AI-powered B2B products, contributing across both front-end and back-end and helping secure new client engagements. Beyond feature development, I’ve streamlined deployment pipelines and improved monitoring to keep delivery smooth and reliable.
exaWizards.name: ExaWizards Inc.

tripTimelinePlanner.description: When traveling to multiple destinations in a row, I found it difficult to keep track of all bookings and details. I developed this app that allows you to manage your travel itinerary, including flights, accommodations, and activities, in a more intuitive way than a simple notepad.
